interpretations: For each distinct media type name, average the `Bytes ÷ Milliseconds` ratios of qualifying tracks, then take the simple average of those media type averages.
For each media type record, average the `Bytes ÷ Milliseconds` ratios of qualifying tracks, then take the simple average of those record-level averages, using names only to identify the media types.
For each distinct media type name, divide the qualifying tracks’ total bytes by their total milliseconds, then take the simple average of those per-name rates.
For each media type record, divide the qualifying tracks’ total bytes by their total milliseconds, then take the simple average of those record-level rates.
queries:
SELECT AVG(media_type_avg)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
      AND t.Milliseconds <> 0
    GROUP BY m.Name
)

SELECT AVG(media_type_avg)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg
    FROM MediaType AS mt
    LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId
)

SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond)
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.Name
)

SELECT AVG(rate)
FROM (
    SELECT CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId
)
